purpose: Document Dindigul's official local cadastral custodian, Tamil Nadu land-record/GIS discovery, and bounded anonymous requests while separating registry evidence from geometry and runtime qualification.
assessment: The official Dindigul district page establishes a local Survey and Land Records custodian and describes digitized textual records, FMS, and village-map work. Official Tamil Nadu e-Services and TNGIS routes were identified, but bounded anonymous requests to the state hosts timed out before current service configuration or a parcel API response could be inspected. No safe native ID, schema, CRS, or polygon geometry was verified, so no GeoJSON sample is retained and runtime remains held.
registryAssessment: registryFound=true is supported by the official Dindigul district Survey and Land Records page naming the local office and its survey/sub-division responsibilities, reinforced by the district's official land e-Services page. This does not establish citywide geometry completeness or ownership/title information.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Dindigul district Survey and Land Records custodian plus Tamil Nadu e-Services/TNGIS.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Local custodian and official service identity only; no live anonymous parcel response obtained.

attempts: Loaded the official Dindigul Survey and Land Records page over TLS (HTTP 200); it identifies the local office and describes F-line/sub-division survey, digitized A-Register/Chitta, FMS computerization, and village-map mosaicing in progress.
Loaded the official Dindigul land e-Services page over TLS (HTTP 200); it links Patta, FMB/Chitta/TSLR, A-Register, verification, and poramboke services.
Performed separate English and Tamil first-party discovery queries and recorded the actual result URLs.
Attempted anonymous access to https://eservices.tn.gov.in/; bounded request timed out after 15 seconds before service configuration or a response could be retained.

Attempted anonymous access to https://tngis.tn.gov.in/ and https://www.tngis.tn.gov.in/apps.html; bounded requests did not complete within the limits, so no JavaScript/configuration, API route, schema, CRS, ID, or geometry was retained.

Did not submit the WUP latitude/longitude to a local endpoint, did not shift the point, did not request owner/address/title/account/tax fields, did not log in, did not bypass CAPTCHA/Cloudflare, and did not disable TLS verification.
No sample GeoJSON was created because no full parcel polygon response or safe native parcel identity was verified.

nextStep: Independent serial review of the current Tamil Nadu e-Services/TNGIS configuration and any public geometry-export capability; keep adapter/runtime held until real safe native IDs and polygon geometry are independently qualified.
